resources.string: What would you like to understand?

Start session sends your goal and learning preferences to OpenAI using the selected connection and billing. Sessions are saved on this device. Knowledge extraction and identity auditing make additional requests using this session’s selected model and billing: automatically after approximately 4096 new assistant-text tokens, or explicitly from the session menu.
Choose your connection and model in Settings first.
ChatGPT account or API key, model and usage
App information and how your data is used
Applies to new sessions. Existing sessions keep their original preferences.
Choose a connection. Billing never switches automatically.
Reasoned is an Android learning prototype using LearnHarness teaching instructions (AGPL-3.0). It is not an official LearnHarness or OpenAI app.

Sessions and learning preferences stay in app-private storage on this device. Credentials use Android Keystore-backed encryption and are excluded from backup.

Starting a turn sends your goal, answers, preferences and session context directly to OpenAI. API-key requests use API billing; ChatGPT requests use the chosen plan’s allowance or credits. No automatic billing fallback.

Requests disable response storage, but this does not guarantee zero provider retention. Keep the session in the foreground while generating.

Your graph stores extracted propositions and reasoning chains with links to their source messages, not mastery assessments. Extractor/Auditor make additional requests using the session’s selected model and billing; processing stops when the app leaves the foreground. The separate sample graph is illustrative.
